sources.entry: LLMKube - Kubernetes operator for self-hosted LLM inference with pluggable runtimes (llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, Ollama, vllm-swift), multi-GPU sharding, NVIDIA CUDA + Apple Silicon Metal support, and OpenAI-compatible API. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go/Docker/K8S

summary.one_liner: LLMKube is a Kubernetes operator that deploys and manages self-hosted LLM inference across mixed hardware (NVIDIA, AMD via Vulkan, Intel, and Apple Silicon), exposing an OpenAI-compatible API.
summary.what_it_does: The operator defines Model and InferenceService custom resources that handle model download and caching, GPU scheduling, health checks, scaling, and an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint. A ModelRouter CRD adds policy-aware routing between local InferenceServices and external providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Bedrock, LiteLLM), with fail-closed behavior for regulated data and per-rule timeouts. The optional Metal Agent runs llama-server, mlx-server, and vllm-swift as native macOS processes to use Apple Silicon Metal GPUs, and registers back into the cluster. Foreman is an opt-in agentic add-on with its own CRDs for running coding-agent pipelines on the fleet. The project also ships a CLI with a model catalog, Prometheus/Grafana monitoring, and Helm charts, with an OpenShift/MicroShift preset.
use_cases: Run LLMs on on-prem or air-gapped Kubernetes clusters
Mix NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, and Apple Silicon hosts in one cluster
Serve an OpenAI-compatible endpoint for internal apps
Route PII-sensitive requests to local models and other requests to cloud APIs
Use Mac Studios as low-latency inference nodes in a Kubernetes cluster
Run batch agentic coding pipelines on local hardware
how_to_run: make install && make run  (from source, after git clone)
notable: Metal Agent runs inference as native macOS processes so Apple Silicon Metal GPUs are usable, while the rest of the cluster sees an ordinary Service
Heterogeneous fleets: NVIDIA, AMD (Vulkan), Intel, and Apple Silicon hosts under one operator and one set of CRDs
ModelRouter enforces fail-closed routing for PII/PHI with apply-time validation and HTTP 503 at runtime instead of cloud fallback
Foreman agentic harness adds Workload, AgenticTask, Agent, and FleetNode CRDs on a separate API group
caveats: Apple Silicon support requires the separate Metal Agent running natively on macOS outside the cluster
README says Ollama is simpler for a single model on one laptop; the project targets multi-node Kubernetes setups
Several features are described as planned or roadmap items (e.g., S3 model source, SafeTensors, multi-node sharding for 70B+ models)
API group is v1alpha1, indicating an early-stage API
